dims_order: x fastest; array index [k][j][i] = z, y, x
affineNote: voxel (i,j,k,1) -> frame mm (x lateral, y anterior, z superior; origin = stapes footplate; a right ear), row-major; origin is the frame position of voxel [0,0,0]
frame: OLSB (js/olsb/volume.js): mm, a right ear, x lateral, y anterior, z superior; (0,0,0) = the stapes footplate of this specimen (OLSB places its origin at the centre of the oval window; they differ by about 1 mm)

window.note: linear display levels over cone-beam CT grey values (not HU): level = 1 + 254 * (value - scanner_min) / (scanner_max - scanner_min), clipped to 1..255; 0 = outside the scan

method: trilinear resampling of the source to a 0.3 mm grid, then sampling into the OLSB-frame box through the rotation of frame.json; box = the Bone bounding box of frame.json plus 2.0 mm; no other processing
attribution: Temporal bone CT derived from the OpenEar library (Sieber et al., Sci Data 2019, doi:10.1038/sdata.2018.297; data doi:10.5281/zenodo.1473724), CC BY 4.0; resampled and cropped.
